The office itself is clean. But they quote whatever prices they want. I went there three times because I couldn't find another ENT specialist. The first time, it was 300 baht for the appointment, plus 200 baht to remove earwax. The second time, it was 300 baht for the appointment, plus 700 baht for medications that cost 200 baht at the pharmacy. And that's despite the fact that I asked for one of them to be removed because my child had been prescribed opioid painkillers. I asked for a receipt stating what I was paying for. They wrote me a piece of paper and didn't bother writing anything down. The price didn't change. The third time, I just needed an examination, and they charged 400 baht for the appointment. The treatment is standard—the antibiotic amoxicillin. If you need an urgent examination, it's a good office. You show up, take a number, and in 1-1.5 hours you'll be seen on a first-come, first-served basis. But making up prices out of thin air is something else!
Good service
